summary: Neha is a solid mid-level recruiter who moved from an agency to Kestrel and now runs engineering and data pipelines nearly alone. The only systems the dataset sees are HR records and learning completions, so her real hiring ability is largely invisible; a fair assessor who sat with her ATS would rate her higher than the available records can show.
archetype: Competent non-tech practitioner with thin digital footprint

oracle.basis: hcm_KC-12248 allocations 'Engineering hiring FY25' Recruiter and 'Engineering and Data hiring FY26' lead for Data roles (organisation), cv_2025_08 end-to-end recruitment, 60+ closures (self), lms Structured Interviewing / calibration courses (training). No ATS, scorecards or work records; org + self + training is not a route to High.

skills.why: Six years of end-to-end hiring (three at an agency), lead recruiter for Data roles since 2025, hiring managers rely on her; ATS history not supplied but allocations and course work fit.

skills.why: Uses the Recruiting module daily for requisitions and offers, with training; no HCM transaction processing or configuration.
